verdict.rationale: Navan's hosted MCP server documents conversational questions about policies, approval flows, and flag/decline reasons, so an AI assistant can explain declines and state what policy applies. Ava also compares spend to policy. Nothing shows an assistant chasing missing receipts or proactively enforcing policy before spend; the MCP is a query interface the user drives. Missing for 10: automated receipt chasing, a documented pre-spend "can I expense this?" check, proactive in-flow enforcement, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI assistant enforces policy conversationally — chasing missing receipts, explaining declines, and answering "can I expense this?" before the spend happens

citations.quote: Ask questions about policies, approval flows, and flag/decline reasons — understand why a transaction was flagged, who needs to approve it, and what policy applies.
The Navan MCP lets you connect Navan to your favorite AI products, so you can query Navan spend and travel data using natural language.
Analyze travel spend and compare it to company policy
